cases.prompt: Design a 12V camper van system: 400W of solar, a 200Ah lithium battery, a 2000W inverter, a 12V fridge and LED lights. Include proper fusing and a battery monitor.

expectations.description: a battery bank is present
an MPPT controller is present
a battery monitor is present
every load declares realistic watts or amps
solar panels declare a PV voltage
